subject: Instrumentation stewardship transfer & rotations
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha@skylab.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@cloudops.io>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Observability scope & start dates for instrumentation stewardship

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for walking the Skylab team through Redwood's deployment options last week. We're ready to kick off the observability/operations handover for our inference pipelines and wanted to outline what we need from Redwood for the first 6 weeks: dashboards (latency percentiles, token-level cost breakdown), tracing hooks for request IDs + model variant, an error taxonomy for model failures vs infra, alert routing for sev2/sev3, and a runbook for token-burst incidents.

Attached is our rough requirements doc and a CSV export of current dashboard owners. High-level asks:
- Week 0: inventory & access (who needs dashboard edit rights, log/metrics retention)
- Week 1–2: tracing hook deployment + naming convention review
- Week 3: alert routing and escalation mapping (PagerDuty + Slack channels)
- Week 4–6: runbook drafting, play-testing, and go/no-go checklist

Can Redwood confirm an internal owner and a proposed kickoff slot next week? Also looping in Samir from CloudOps who will handle our k8s side.

Thanks,
Aisha Gupta
Director of Platform Engineering | Skylab AI
Attachments: Skylab-obs-requirements.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Subject: Re: Observability scope & start dates for instrumentation stewardship

Aisha —

Appreciate the clear outline. I'll own the Redwood side as CS lead for this engagement. Proposed kickoff: Tue, May 28 10:00am PT (30–45 min) — will cover inventory, roles, and immediate blockers. Attendees from our side: Laura (observability eng), Marissa (implementation PM), and me.

Initial notes after a quick scan of the attachment:
- We can map dashboard ownership to our per-route dashboards; we'll need a short list of the 6 most-critical routes you care about (model infer + embed).
- Tracing hooks: prefer request_id + model_variant + shard_id as tags. We'll share a small snippet for insertion into your request pipeline prior to the model call.
- For alert routing, we typically map Sev2 to on-call SRE + CS on-call; Sev3 to a channel-only alert for async review. We can customize per your PD schedules.

I've attached a short "initial inventory" template to speed the kickoff. Please confirm the slot and paste the 6 critical routes into the sheet before the meeting if possible.

Best,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: initial-inventory.csv (CSV)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha@skylab.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability scope & start dates for instrumentation stewardship

Thanks Ben / Aisha — following up with technical prep items so we can move quickly in the first two weeks.

1) Tracing hooks (implementation proposal)- Insert before the call to Redwood's inference endpoint so the request has these fields: request_id, user_id (hashed), model_variant, seq_len, route_name. Example (pseudo-HTTP header):

  X-SKYLAB-REQUEST-ID: 123e4567-89ab-cdef-1234-56789abcdef0
  X-SKYLAB-MODEL-VARIANT: gptx-8k-q4_1
  X-SKYLAB-ROUTE: infer/recommend

We recommend emitting a span around the tokenization and a span around the inference call to capture token duration.

2) Naming conventions / tag taxonomy (suggested)
- route_name: service/feature (e.g., inference/recommend)
- model_variant: family-size-quant (e.g., gptx-8k-q4_1)
- error_type: model_timeout | kv_miss | decoding_error | infra_oom

3) Dashboard requirements checklist
- Latency p50/p90/p99 by route and by model_variant
- Token-level cost: tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_per_1k_tokens
- Error counts and error_type breakdown

4) Runbook skeleton (we'll draft):
- Detection: alert triggers + immediate triage (who paged)
- Mitigation: steps to failover to smaller variant, strip context, or reduce batch size
- Postmortem: data to collect (traces, KV metrics, token histograms)

Can Marissa please confirm the doc owner for compiling the runbook and the Slack channel Skylab wants for escalation? Marissa — can you also confirm whether Skylab has PD escalation windows?

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Observability Engineer | Redwood Inference
